name: Yagate Hi wa Ochiru
source:
One day, I discovered the true nature of the lover I had sworn to marry.
I can't forgive that guy who shattered what was precious to me and took all I had.
I refuse to just let this happen, yet I felt utterly powerless.


God. Anyone. Anyone at all. At this point, even a demon'll do.
Please, help me.
Drag that bastard down to hell...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13330]Novelgame[/url]]
